features:
- [BAN VA PHONE FARM] Dong bo duma.prop chuan key=value, don sach tan du /data/domaconf & device.json, giam loi tre ADB va SIGABRT Bluetooth khi Change/Restore hang loat.
- [PLAY INTEGRITY & SPOOFER] Toi uu khieng bao ve Play Integrity (dat chuan MEETS_BASIC + MEETS_DEVICE) va tu dong phuc hoi cau hinh lucas_spoofer khi mat dong bo.
- [WINDOWS SECURITY & DLL] Tu dong go khoa Zone.Identifier va nap DLL an toan khi giai nen goi ZIP tren Windows, chong loi crash khi khoi dong.
- [OTA 5S v5.0.1] Dong goi chuan Resources/runtime (11 Standalone DLL + CLI + HMAC-SHA256 runtime_seal.dat) va cap nhat nhan dien phien ban 5.0.1.
